input.title: Induced Automation Innovation: Evidence from Firm-Level Patent Data
input.authors: David Hémous; Morten Olsen; Carlo Zanella; Antoine Dechezleprêtre

verdicts.reasoning: Main DV is the firm-year count of automation patents, estimated via Poisson PML (ppmlhdfe) with firm, industry-year, and country-year FE — treated as log-DV per the schema. Log wages and log knowledge stocks appear on the RHS as controls, not as the DV. Identification uses a shift-share / Bartik IV (Borusyak–Hull–Jaravel) on foreign wages for domestic labor costs. Splits by patent type (auto vs non-auto, placebo) and shock source (Hartz, minimum wage, robustness) are not firm-subgroup heterogeneity.
